title: algo-poc — money-critical overview
description: T6 first-draft dashboard: orders, fills, kill events, risk breaches, DLQ depth, Redis memory, and per-service heartbeat age. Panels are intentionally simple (rate/increase over a window) — refine thresholds/visuals once this has run against real data.

panels.title: Orders approved / rejected (per 5m)
panels.description: algo_order_lifecycle_transitions_total by status. RISK_REJECTED here is entry-time rejections only — see the separate Risk breaches panel for breaches on already-held positions.

panels.title: Kill events (stream:kill entries added, per 5m)
panels.description: Should be flat at 0 almost always — any nonzero value is notable. Mirrors the KillStreamActivity alert.

panels.title: Risk breaches — passive scan (per 15m, by type)
panels.description: algo_risk_breach_total, incremented in RiskServiceRunner.run_passive_scan() for stop-loss/ceiling/margin breaches on held positions. Empty until T2 wires run_passive_scan() into run() on main.

panels.title: Dead-letter queue depth, by stream
panels.description: redis_stream_length for every *:dlq stream. Alert threshold (DeadLetterQueueBacklog) fires at 10.

panels.title: Redis memory usage vs maxmemory
panels.description: redis_memory_used_bytes / redis_memory_max_bytes. RedisMemoryHigh alerts at 0.8; noeviction rejects writes at 1.0.

panels.title: Heartbeat age, by service
panels.description: algo_heartbeat_age_seconds, recomputed fresh on every scrape (independent of a wedged main loop — see shared/heartbeat.py). A climbing line for one job means that service's loop stopped iterating; compare against the HeartbeatStale / HeartbeatStaleDataIngestion alert thresholds (120s / 2700s).
